name: three-d-carousel

frames.best_why: The drum curve is clear and the centred photos are all readable with no cursor over them.

tagline: A drum of photos spins sideways in draggable 3D perspective.
summary: A rotating cylinder of square photos that you drag sideways to spin; clicking a photo stops the carousel and opens that image large in an overlay.
appearance: On a near-black stage, a row of square photos stands around an invisible cylinder, tilted by perspective at both edges. Each photo sits on a dark rounded tile with a small gap between tiles.
behaviour: Dragging sideways spins the drum and a spring carries it after release; clicking a photo pauses it and grows the image in an overlay, and clicking the overlay closes it.
demo_content: Unsplash photos of landscapes, a coffee cup, a person, a black object and a tennis court.
search_phrases: photos arranged in a spinning ring
three dimensional photo reel for a website
click a photo to enlarge it
interactive photo wall you can spin
use_when: You want an explorable photo gallery that feels physical and can open a single shot on click.
avoid_when: There is no keyboard or button control; on touch a stray drag spins it, and it needs a wide container.
customise: Photos are a fixed internal Unsplash list; changing images or keywords means editing the source, and the component accepts no props.
weight_why: A dozen large photos plus drag and spring motion; no per-frame loop.

a11y.note: No keyboard control and no reduced-motion handling; alt text is a placeholder like keyword_0 plus the raw URL.

issues: The carousel cannot be spun by keyboard and has no visible controls.
Alt text is an index plus a raw URL, so the photos are not described.
The enlarged photo has no close button; it relies on clicking the backdrop.
polish_why: Drum reads clearly in 3D and the spin is smooth; placeholder alt text and no controls.
title: 3D Carousel
